summary: Sets up the Loading Grid message: runs state cleanup, resets the state/session field at this+0x178 to -1, and in championship mode (dword_7D0410 == 5) verifies the Loading Grid string is present in the string table, copies it into the display buffer byte_5EC4CC, and creates a UI menu item. Otherwise falls through returning the earlier cleanup result.

operations.description: Run state cleanup via StateCleanupNotification(this) and retain its result for the fallthrough return.
Reset the state/session identifier field at this+0x178 (this[94]) to -1.
Enter the Loading Grid setup path only when the mode global dword_7D0410 equals 5 (championship mode).
Verify the Loading Grid string aLoadingGrid exists in the string table via BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, aLoadingGrid, byte_5EC4CC).
Copy the Loading Grid string aLoadingGrid character by character into the display buffer byte_5EC4CC until the null terminator is reached.
In championship mode, create the UI menu item via UIMenuItemCreator(this, byte_5EC4CC, byte_5EA438, byte_5EA438, byte_5EA438, 0) and return its result.
Outside championship mode, return the earlier StateCleanupNotification result unchanged.

clean_pseudocode: do { c = aLoadingGrid[i]; byte_5EC4CC[i++] = c; } while (c);
return UIMenuItemCreator(this, byte_5EC4CC, byte_5EA438, byte_5EA438, byte_5EA438, 0);
unresolved: Semantics of the three-argument BinarySearchInStringTable form and whether this copy loop is the only population path for byte_5EC4CC.
Meaning of the three identical byte_5EA438 arguments passed to UIMenuItemCreator is defined by that callee.
Whether the copy loop overwrites prior display-buffer content and how the buffer is bounded is unverified.
